pages: Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, writes on the board hung beside the mill door with one stub of white chalk. Middle: the open doorway, a barrow standing on the boards. Background: the leat and the tall wheel below. Light: low morning sun.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, crouches at the stone shaft and turns one pinion of nine wooden staves. Middle: the cog wheel of iron teeth overhead, an oil can on the boards. Background: the mill floor, the hopper. Light: shaft light, low and grey.

Abel Ninnis, a man of fifty-three, grey stubble, a brown waistcoat over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, drives one millstone pick down into the face of a stone lying flat on the boards. Middle: the runner stone, a bushel measure on its side. Background: the cold mill floor, bare windows. Light: hard winter daylight.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, tips one wooden bushel measure of wheat into the pan of the mill scales. Middle: the brass scale and its weights, the toll sack. Background: the stone floor, the hoppers above. Light: low daylight from the mill window.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, holds one white flour sack open on the boards and scoops flour into it. Middle: a wooden scoop, the bushel measure. Background: the meal bin, sacks stacked to the roof. Light: bright morning on a flour day.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, stands knee-deep in the pond and lays one hand flat on the gauge plank. Middle: cracked mud, cut reeds. Background: the mill wall, the wheel beyond. Light: high hard drought light.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, lies under the mill floor and lifts one pinion of six wooden staves from the deal box. Middle: the open box, a coil of rope. Background: floor joists overhead, the stopped wheel shaft. Light: low light through the boards.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, holds his reddened hand above one heap of grey hot meal in the trough, fingers spread. Middle: a sack on its side, a wooden scoop. Background: the millstones, the dusty floor. Light: low evening sun through the doorway.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, stands beside the turning stone shaft with one hand on the iron casing. Middle: a tin lamp on the boards, a heap of meal. Background: the hopper, white dust in the air. Light: lamp light and one shaft window.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, draws one flat file along the frame of the sluice board, forearm braced on it. Middle: a jar of emery powder, an oil can. Background: the dry head of the leat, the mill wall. Light: bright daylight.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, wades the leat and pushes one long straight stick down into the mud of the bed. Middle: the barrow on the bank, handles up. Background: the wheel, the oak launder. Light: flat overcast September light.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, leans one hand on the top of the iron stove in the lean-to. Middle: a sack of meal by the plank wall, a tin pail. Background: the lean-to, the mill door. Light: red glow off the open stove door.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, kneels and lays one palm flat on the furrows of the runner stone, face up. Middle: the hopper, the bushel measure. Background: the mill floor, the deal box. Light: low winter light from a small window.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, holds one millstone pick across both hands, an ash handle with an iron bar at the end. Middle: the folded oiled paper on the shelf, an oil can. Background: the mill shop shelves. Light: cold daylight.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, sets the pick into the stone and cuts a furrow, following the line he has already cut. Middle: one flour sack against the wall, the bushel measure. Background: the mill floor, the cold stones. Light: grey dawn light.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, sets one pinion of twelve wooden staves onto the stone shaft and drives it home. Middle: a wooden mallet, a spanner on the boards. Background: the stopped wheel, the launder. Light: daylight from the open mill door.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, kneels at the mill door with one open sack of pale meal between his knees. Middle: a wooden scoop, the brass scale. Background: the leat, a cart standing outside. Light: morning light in the doorway.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, lifts one white sack of flour on his shoulder and turns it in the doorway light. Middle: the bushel measure, a coil of rope. Background: the running wheel beyond the door. Light: bright winter morning.

Abel Ninnis, a man of fifty-three, grey stubble, a brown waistcoat over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, reads one open ledger on the lean-to table with a finger on the line. Middle: a pencil, the folded receipt. Background: the plank wall, the stove. Light: grey window light and a low lamp.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, writes in one open ledger on the lean-to table, pencil to the line under the last figure. Middle: a folded receipt, a tin lamp. Background: the stove, the plank wall. Light: low lamplight and a grey window.

Elias, a boy of fifteen, dark brown hair, a grey flannel shirt with the sleeves turned back, a brown leather apron, writes on the board by the mill door with one stub of white chalk, then turns to the leat. Middle: the open door, the sluice frame. Background: the wheel taking the water. Light: clear Monday morning.
